title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 8: the vision of Jerusalem - the image of jealousy, the hole in the wall and men worshiping the sun.

questions.text: Who sat before him in his house when the Lord Yahweh's hand fell on him?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:1 says that as he sat in his house, the elders of Judah sat before him, and the Lord Yahweh's hand fell on him there.

answers.text: The priests of the sanctuary
The elders of Judah
The women weeping for Tammuz
Twenty-five men worshiping the sun

questions.text: How was he brought to Jerusalem in the visions of God?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:3 says a form of a hand took him by a lock of his head, and the Spirit lifted him up between earth and the sky and brought him to Jerusalem.

answers.text: Taken by a lock of his head and lifted up by the Spirit
Carried in a chariot of fire
Led by the hand of an angel on the road
He travelled there on foot in seven days

questions.text: What was at the door of the gate of the inner court that looks toward the north?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:3 says that there was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provokes to jealousy.

answers.text: The bronze altar
A throne like a sapphire stone
The porch of the temple
The seat of the image of jealousy

questions.text: What was he told to do at the wall of the court, and what did he find?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:7-8 says he saw a hole in the wall, was told to dig in the wall, and when he had dug he saw a door.

answers.text: Break the wall down, and he saw the altar
Measure the wall, and he found a scroll
Dig in the wall, and he saw a door
Climb the wall, and he saw the city

questions.text: What did he see portrayed around on the wall inside?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:10 says he saw every form of creeping things, abominable animals, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed around on the wall.

answers.text: Creeping things, abominable animals and all the idols of the house of Israel
Four living creatures, each one with four faces and wings
Wheels full of eyes, high and dreadful all around them
The sun, the moon and all the stars of the sky

questions.text: How many men of the elders of the house of Israel stood there, and who stood in the middle of them?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:11 says seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel stood before them, with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan in the middle, each man with his censer in his hand.

answers.text: Twenty-five men, with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan
Seventy men, with Buzi the priest
Twelve men, with Shaphan the scribe
Seventy men, with Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan

questions.text: What did the elders say in the dark, each in his rooms of imagery?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:12 says they say, "Yahweh doesn't see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land."

answers.text: "The vision is for many days to come."
"Yahweh doesn't see us. Yahweh has forsaken the land."
"Our fathers sinned, and not we."
"The temple will never be thrown down."

questions.text: What were the women doing at the door of the north gate of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:14 says he saw the women sit there weeping for Tammuz.

answers.text: Burning incense to the sun
Grinding grain at millstones
Sitting and weeping for Tammuz
Singing before the altar

questions.text: What were the men between the porch and the altar doing in the inner court?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:16 says about twenty-five men stood with their backs toward Yahweh's temple and their faces toward the east, worshiping the sun.

answers.text: Seventy men were offering incense in their censers
Six men stood there with their slaughter weapons
Twelve men were blowing trumpets at the gate
About twenty-five men were worshiping the sun toward the east

questions.text: What does he say he will do though they cry in his ears with a loud voice?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 8:18 says he will deal in wrath, his eye will not spare and he will have no pity, and though they cry with a loud voice he will not hear them.

answers.text: He will relent and spare the city
He will send them one more prophet
He will not hear them
He will wait another forty years
